blocks.en: Coordinate Transformations and Sobolev Spaces on Manifolds
blocks.zh: 坐标变换与流形上的 Sobolev 空间
blocks.label: subsec:sobolev-coordinate-transformations-manifolds

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $\partial\Omega$ is smooth, a standard trick is to make local changes of coordinates which make $\partial\Omega$ a coordinate surface. This requires us to consider how Sobolev spaces behave under coordinate transformations. Also, for boundary-value problems in PDEs we need to consider spaces of functions defined on $\partial\Omega$. Hence we want to define Sobolev spaces on manifolds. These will of course be defined in terms of local coordinate charts; again the behavior under coordinate transformations is a crucial issue.
blocks.zh: 若 $\partial\Omega$ 光滑, 一个标准技巧是作局部坐标变换, 使 $\partial\Omega$ 成为坐标曲面. 这要求考察 Sobolev 空间在坐标变换下如何变化. 此外, 对 PDE 的边值问题, 需要考察定义在 $\partial\Omega$ 上的函数空间. 因而希望定义流形上的 Sobolev 空间. 当然, 这些空间将通过局部坐标卡来定义; 坐标变换下的行为同样是一个关键问题.

blocks.en: Let $\bm{\Phi}:\Omega\to\Omega^{\prime}$ be a $k$-diffeomorphism. Then $\bm{\Phi}^*$ and $(\bm{\Phi}^{-1})^*$ are bounded linear mappings from $H^k(\Omega^{\prime})$ to $H^k(\Omega)$ and, respectively, from $H^k(\Omega)$ to $H^k(\Omega^{\prime})$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\bm{\Phi}:\Omega\to\Omega^{\prime}$ 为 $k$ 阶微分同胚. 那么 $\bm{\Phi}^*$ 和 $(\bm{\Phi}^{-1})^*$ 分别为从 $H^k(\Omega^{\prime})$ 到 $H^k(\Omega)$ 以及从 $H^k(\Omega)$ 到 $H^k(\Omega^{\prime})$ 的有界线性映射.
blocks.label: thm:sobolev-integer-order-pullback

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Since the inverse of a $k$-diffeomorphism is also a $k$-diffeomorphism, it suffices to prove the claim for $\bm{\Phi}^*$. It is easy to see that $\bm{\Phi}^*$ is a bounded linear mapping from $\widetilde L^2(\Omega^{\prime})$ to $\widetilde L^2(\Omega)$ and hence, by continuity, from $L^2(\Omega^{\prime})$ to $L^2(\Omega)$. We note that $(u,v)_{\Omega^{\prime}}=(\bm{\Phi}^*u,(\det\nabla\bm{\Phi})\bm{\Phi}^*v)_{\Omega}$.

It remains to consider derivatives. For this, we have to establish that the derivatives of $\bm{\Phi}^*u$ can be evaluated in the usual way by means of the chain and product rule. This is clear if $u\in C^{\infty}(\Omega)$, and we have already established that $C^{\infty}$-functions are dense in $H^k(\Omega)$. For $u\in H^k(\Omega)\cap C^{\infty}(\Omega)$, any $p$th derivative of $\bm{\Phi}^*u$ $(p\leq k)$ is a linear expression involving derivatives of $u$ of orders $\leq p$, with coefficients depending on derivatives of $\bm{\Phi}$; in particular, all the coefficients are bounded, continuous functions. In order to extend the result to all of $H^k(\Omega)$, we need to be able to take limits. The following lemma establishes that we can do this.
blocks.zh:
由于 $k$ 阶微分同胚的逆也是 $k$ 阶微分同胚, 只需对 $\bm{\Phi}^*$ 证明断言. 容易看出 $\bm{\Phi}^*$ 为从 $\widetilde L^2(\Omega^{\prime})$ 到 $\widetilde L^2(\Omega)$ 的有界线性映射, 因而由连续性也是从 $L^2(\Omega^{\prime})$ 到 $L^2(\Omega)$ 的有界线性映射. 注意 $(u,v)_{\Omega^{\prime}}=(\bm{\Phi}^*u,(\det\nabla\bm{\Phi})\bm{\Phi}^*v)_{\Omega}$.

还需考察导数. 为此, 需要证明 $\bm{\Phi}^*u$ 的导数可按通常方式利用链式法则和乘积法则计算. 若 $u\in C^{\infty}(\Omega)$, 这显然成立, 并且已经证明 $C^{\infty}$ 函数在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中稠密. 对 $u\in H^k(\Omega)\cap C^{\infty}(\Omega)$, $\bm{\Phi}^*u$ 的任意第 $p$ 阶导数 $(p\leq k)$ 都是涉及 $u$ 的 $\leq p$ 阶导数的线性表达式, 其系数依赖于 $\bm{\Phi}$ 的导数; 特别地, 所有系数都是有界连续函数. 为将结果延拓到整个 $H^k(\Omega)$, 需要能够取极限. 以下引理表明可以这样做.

blocks.en: Let $u\in L^2(\Omega)\cap C(\Omega)$ and $a\in C_b(\Omega)$. Then $au\in L^2(\Omega)$ and $\|au\|_2\leq\|a\|_{\infty}\|u\|_2$.
blocks.zh: 设 $u\in L^2(\Omega)\cap C(\Omega)$, $a\in C_b(\Omega)$. 那么 $au\in L^2(\Omega)$, 且 $\|au\|_2\leq\|a\|_{\infty}\|u\|_2$.
blocks.label: lem:l-two-bounded-continuous-multiplier

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We omit the trivial proof of the lemma. Since $L^2(\Omega)\cap C(\Omega)$ is dense in $L^2(\Omega)$, the lemma allows us to define $au$ for every $u\in L^2(\Omega)$. This completes the proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-integer-order-pullback}.
blocks.zh: 略去该引理的显然证明. 由于 $L^2(\Omega)\cap C(\Omega)$ 在 $L^2(\Omega)$ 中稠密, 该引理使我们可以对每个 $u\in L^2(\Omega)$ 定义 $au$. 至此完成 Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-integer-order-pullback} 的证明.
